balls.text: Hard length, no room and Johnson can only cloth a cut to cover point. He cleared the front foot and Hazlewood cramped him. He's hit the pitch and it's worked out at the death
Another pull, this is sliced though. Skied and the keeper runs to the left, gets in line with the ball and takes it while reaching forward.
Finally some contact with the pull, it's a top edge that goes over the keeper but KKR will take that
And another short ball. This is seam-up and rises around shoulder-height if not a touch higher. Harshit misses the pull again, checks with the square-leg ump if it's wide. Not given

Smart bowling again, more margin for error with Hazlewood going short. The extra bounce is making it tougher for Harshit to connect with the pull. This was outside off too and he couldn't drag it across. He wanted to sneak a bye but the keeper jogged down to keep him in check.
Into the pitch, well over the pull. 130ks but it zips off the pitch, Hazlewood's height helping out too. Harshit was making room and got followed.

Fullish length ball on off, 134ks, the Harshit cleared his front leg and had to settle for a square drive to deep point. The way he shaped it, it seemed like he wanted to go leg side. The left-armer's angle didn't allow him

Sound as ball passes bat, yes, there's a feather as Raghuvanshi pulled. 134ks scramble-seam ball on a shortish length lands around off and angles away. The batter tried to whack it square from the top of the bounce.
Raghuvanshi can't launch the three-quarter ball on the up, finds mid-off
Pace on again, doesn't follow the batter as he went across to fourth stump. The length ball was on top of off, the batter had to crawl back for the whip through square leg
Shortish ball at the body, Raghuvanshi pulls it to deep fine leg. 134ks
Yes, the first ball is very wide outside off. Slower one on a back of a length, sticks into the pitch a touch. Ramandeep has to reach out for the cut to cover. Not middled
Dipping yorker on fourth, 133ks, jammed to deep third
Goes across to chase the wide length ball, flat-bats it over the bowler's head. Kohli cleans up near the straight boundary

Slower one is tonked over cow corner. It's a knuckle ball on the fuller side of length, fourth-stump line. The ball comes off the pitch with even pace, Raghuvanshi went back in the crease, maintained a stable base and extended an on-drive with max power
Tries to flick it, but gets beaten. Ball goes off the pad to the off side
Raghuvanshi premeditates, goes well across and inside the line of the shortish ball that was going outside the off-side tramline. Gets it off the sticker to the keeper's left
Tall Josh gets extra bounce to beat the pull. 130ks, back of length at best, fourth-stump line, it kicks up and goes well above the top edge
Perfect over for RCB, just four off it. Length ball with a bit of room to finish, cut with the spin but finds point. M
Another non-attacking shot. Flicked off the back foot through midwicket
Leading edge off the gentle flick goes straight to point. Length ball lobbed up at leg stump. RCB will take this
Fullish on off at 93ks, pushed with an open faced towards point
Flicked behind square off the back foot
Spin and bounce. Legbreak on a length lands on middle and goes over off, Ramandeep goes square on for the pull to long-on, has to adjust to the height
Fullish on middle and leg, Ramandeep was a touch too far across, manages to flick it through square leg
Fullish around fourth, clipped through midwicket

Suyash gets Russell with a googly, just 87ks. Landed on fourth, may have drifted away a touch. Spun back sharply, Russell committed to the shot and got nothing on it. Middle stump and leg stump form a V. 107 for 1 has turned into 150 for 6.
A touch wide, a touch short and Russell wallops a cut behind point
Googly on a length, spins into leg stump after landing on middle and off. Defended with a straight bat, to the bowler's left
Square drives a length ball on fourth to deep point

Stump-to-stump does it again. Krunal completes his spell by knocking top of off, he's ensured KKR couldn't run away with the game in the middle overs after a flier. No turn on that, didn't look that short. Rinku went for the pull but that skidded through, went below the bat
Length around off, clipped to long-on,
Fullish length ball is swept from off stump to deep midwicket
Did that pitch down leg? Looked to have scooted at pace, which is why Rinku was beaten on the stationary close-faced flick. Hit just under the knee-roll. Hawk-Eye confirms it did pitch down leg
Touch short. Top of middle, 98ks, eases a pull to deep square leg
Length on the pads, clipped through midwicket
Length just down leg, clipped to long leg
Full on leg, clipped through square leg. Fielder has to run a few metres, that allows two
Not that short, outside off too, but it's dragged through midwicket with a pull.
Length on fourth, clipped through square leg
Length on off, short-arm flick from the crease takes it to long-on
Chops the off-stump length ball with a vertical bat, gets it towards backward point
Sweeps the fullish ball from just outside off to deep midwicket
Shovel-flicks a length ball from fifth stump through midwicket. Vertical-bat shot
Quick single to short third. Guided from top of off stump with a soft open-faced bat
Flicked from the stumps, off the back foot, through square leg
Full on middle, 99ks, driven to long-off

RCB continue to fight back, Krunal's pace outdoes Venkatesh. 101ks, on a length, angling away from around the wicket through fourth stump. Venkatesh was upright for a while, then one foot went up as he tried to force a flick through midwicket. Inside edged it onto middle. Krunal pumps his fists with ferocity

Venkatesh wasn't wearing a helmet, he calls for one right away after Krunal bumps him. That's a pacer's bouncer but too high, touch down leg too. The batter ducked out, all reflexes there, the keeper did well to half-stop it
Heavy wrist-work in that cut, played it after the length ball passed him. Got real low too to keep it on the ground; through backward point it races. Suyash being taken down
Off the front stool, big stride forward and the bat swing on the cover drive is seamless.
Much quicker, tighter line too. Lands around fourth stump, on a length, and spins in a touch. Venkatesh was hurried on the one-legged cover drive, edged it to short third. Good fielding there

Dragged down and the pull has been launched over backward square leg. Suyash has had a few of these, this was down leg too. Venkatesh swivelled in the crease, all torso, and he wound himself up quite a bit. Didn't middle it, missed out on the six as it landed a few feet inside the ropes
Googly on a fullish length lands on fourth and turns away, 87ks, carved to point
Length at the stumps, a touch loopy, clipped to square leg
Fullish down leg, clipped to midwicket
Dances down and clips it off a lengtht to midwicket. Fielder keeps the non-striker honest with a shy at the stumps
Fullish on leg, clipped through square leg

Pulled straight to deep-backward square leg, that's Rahane falling into the trap. Looked like he wanted to clear the boundary but couldn't generate enough power on the 98ks length ball on the pads. Shot was on, he went deep in the crease, and tried to lift it from down to up while on one knee. Just ended up finding the man. Two quick wickets for RCB
Length on middle and off, 99ks, dart stuff. Flicked to deep midwicket
Length on middle, clipped to long-on off the back foot
Finally, finally a wicket for Rasikh and he lets Narine know! Sharp back of a length ball at 132kph outside off. He throws his bat at it, gets a thick outside edge, and Jitesh does the rest.
The 100 stand is up and what a way to get there! Back of a hand slower ball at 105kph on off. He steps to the leg side, and flat-bats this over long-on for a huge six.
Slower offcutter outside off, Narine backs away and misses
On-pace shin-high full toss on middle, he backs away and muscles him past extra cover. Places this brilliantly.
Another slower short of a length on off at 106kph. He gives himself plenty of room and hacks the pull to deep midwicket
How's that missed the stumps? Slower back of a length ball on middle, the ball keeps a little low as well. Rahane gets a thick inside-edge on the pull and the ball just evades leg stump
Bludgeoned! Flatter wrong'un outside off. He stays still and muscles this straight over the bowler's head.
Out of the screws! Fuller googly outside off, and this time Narine slams it out of the middle of the bat and clears the ropes in the gap between deep extra cover and long-off
Falls in no-man's land. Tossed up wrong'un outside off. He looks to go over extra cover, skews it off the outside half of the blade. But the ball falls in between long-off and deep extra cover
Tossed up outside off, he mistimes his chip straighter to deep cover this time
Backs away outside off and lofts the good length ball over extra cover. Salt gets across to his right from deep cover, slips but recovers to keep the batters down to two
Going, going, gone and that's a 25-ball fifty for Rahane. What a start for Rahane, the KKR captain. Legbreak outside off, he bends down on one knee and slams the sweep miles over deep midwicket
Fuller and down leg, called a wide
Slower back of a length ball outside off, he thrashes this to the right of Kohli at extra cover, who makes a one-handed stop
Fuller and on-pace outside off, he opens the face of the bat and guides this in the gap between point and short third for four more
Slower offcutter outside off, he goes for a cross-batted swipe, and misses

Nicely done. Sharp short of a length ball on middle, he sways outside the line. That is called a wide for height. Think there is a minor appeal for hit wicket as Narine's bat hit the stumps, but that was well after the delivery was lodged into the keeper's gloves
Slower back of a length ball on off, Rahane backs away looking to thrash that away. He can only mistime as far as long-on
Wide yorker well outside off. Narine throws his hands at it and gets it off the cue-end of the bat to Jitesh who dives to his left and saves a certain four
Slower offcutter but that is well outside the tramline outside off. Called a wide
On a length on leg stump, Rahane misses the flick and is rapped on the pad. An appeal for lbw from Dar and Jitesh but that was going down leg. No review taken.
Short oof a length ball outside off at 97kph. Rahane punches this off the backfoot but only as far as long-off
Very, very quick outside off as Rahane misses out. Legbreak at 98.2kph, Rahane shapes up for the cut, but is beaten
Flatter legbreak at 92kph on middle. He was looking to work that away to the on-side, gets a thick inside-edge onto pad
Googly turning back into Rahane but still outside off. He watches closely and pats to point
Short and wide, and this time he does not miss out. Goes back, waits for it and opens the face of the bat at the last moment on the cut to place it in the gap between backward point and deep cover
Flatter short of a length ball well outside off, Rahane lets that go. But that,  I think was just inside the tramline. The umpire agrees
Angles the length ball just outside off, he opens the face of the bat and guides to deep third
RCB are leaking runs. The slower ball gone wrong for Dayal. Back of a hand, but that ends up being a knee-high full toss outside off. Rahane places this neatly to the left of point for four more
Rahane at his dismissive best! Wayward length ball on his pads, he gets across and flicks this to the right of deep backward square leg for six more

Top edge, and he gets four. Wasn't where he intended, but that's not going to bother Rahane. Was a length ball at 130kph on off. He looks for a cross-batted swipe, the ball takes the outside edge and goes over short third.
On the fuller side outside off, he skews it off the outside edge to deep point on the bounce
WHIPPED... with disdain. Backs away outside leg and Dayal follows him. The full ball is on his pads and he whacks this through midwicket
Just chipped over the infield, but that's enough.  Pushed quicker on leg stump. He takes a step down the track and times him over mid-on. Never tried to hit that hard
He is in the mood! Flatter on leg stump, he goes for the sweep and slams this past square leg for a four again
Darted in on leg stump at 97kph. He goes reverse but can't connect and is rapped on the pad. Stifle appeal but that was going down leg.
Flatter on leg stump rather just outside. Rahane backs away but is cramped for room as he works this to square leg
Fuller and on middle and leg at 111kph. He whips this with authority again, but long-on gets across in time
Narine won't let Pandya settle. Length ball darted on off. Narine gets under and smokes this 89m over wide long-on
Outswinger on a length outside off, Rahane opens the face of the bat and runs this fine but can't beat short third
WOWZA! On a length on off stump at 130kph. Rahane steps forward, and absolutely hammers this cross-batted for a 92m six over cow corner.
Goes fuller outside off, Rahane square drives crisply but straight to backward point
That's the first six of IPL 2025, and it's fitting the KKR captain is the one to hit it. Good length ball on middle, he swivels and pulls over deep backward square leg for a huge six
Down leg and punished! Length ball on his pads, Rahane shuffles across and comfortably helps this to the vacant fine leg boundary. That will give him some confidence
Good start. Sharp back of a length ball cutting back into Rahane, who shapes up for the cut but is cramped for room. Bunts it to covers
Hazlewood is not giving anything away. Short of a good length on middle, he takes his right leg out of the way, but can only mistime back to the bowler
Back of a length ball on off, he takes a step to the leg side but can only mistime his shovel to mid-on
Top edge that goes over the keeper's head. Banged in short on leg stump. He backs away once more, is rushed into the pull, but is lucky the top-edge goes over the Jitesh's head
Another swing and a miss! Back of a length ball shaping away from Narine outside off, he backs away but can't connect
Look at the pace and carry on that! Good length ball outside off that pitches and skids off the surface as Narine swishes and misses. Jitesh collects that chest high to his right
Back of a length on middle, he backs away looking for a hack, misses
Fuller swinging in on leg stump, Rahane misses the flick and is caught on the pad. But the ball was comfortably sliding down
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, he takes a step to the legside and mistimes his pull towards mid-on
Fuller veering away from Narine outside off. He stays leg side of the ball and slices to cover-point
Back of a length ball shaping away from Narine well outside off. He has a swish at it, backing away but can't connect
Fuller on middle, he stays legside of the ball and digs back to the bowler

Huge appeal first ball. Is Narine strangled down leg?? Jitesh is very confident. He is off straight away, so is the bowler. But, Patidar will not review. On a length on leg stump, the ball flicks his pad through to the keeper.
On a length on off stump, Rahane prods forward and defends

De Kock can't cash in on the reprieve. He is out of here two balls later. Sharp back of a length ball shaping into de Kock. He is on the move looking to punch this through covers. Is too close to the ball, and can only manage a thick inside-edge to the right of the keeper who takes a lovely catch low.
Back of a length ball  shaping away, he leaves it alone

Spooned straight up, and that will be taken... oh it won't be! Suyash Sharma has dropped a sitter third ball of IPL 2025. Back of a length ball outside of, he goes for a pull, gets a top edge with the ball ballooning straight up. He comes around from short midwicket and shells it
There's the first boundary of IPL 2025! Stifle short and wide, de Kock gets into position nice and early and cuts this fiercely past point
On a length just around off stump,  de Kock pushes towards point

Whacked to the right of mid-on and 17 years after RCB were thumped by KKR in an IPL opener, they return the favour. It finishes with a length ball outside off that was heaved across with a semi-horizontal bat.

Hooked over RCB's dugout. Livingstone greeted with another short ball, this wasn't bad. Around top of shoulder height, fourth-stump line. The batter went across, got inside the line of the ball, leant to the off side and swung in front of his face. Went very fine, and well over deep fine leg
Length just outside off, square driven to deep point
Under-edged to the keeper on the bounce. Was a length ball on fifth that Livingstone tried to slap to the leg side with a horizontal bat
Pulled just behind square. Half-tracker at chest-height, Livingstone's head turned leg side as the bat swooshed across, but it was in one full motion

Pulled, timing's not bad but he finds deep midwicket. Great innings nonetheless, just 13 now needed off 27. Was a length ball around off, another languid bat swing, Rinku ran in and took it on the move
More effortlessness. Smart batting too. Patidar pulled the length ball arriving towards his ribs, but he hollowed in his belly to lift the ball over short fine leg rather than go square.
Length on fourth, driven on the up to mid-off

That's a late cut played like a lifted drive. The hard-length ball was rising, it was in the channel, Patidar stood leg side of the ball, leapt up while wristily carving the ball. The bat went from low to up, the toe was facing point and the hand speed was remarkable
Wowza, that is a serene square drive that races to the point boundary. Harshit not happy with the fielding... and replays show that the ball wasn't that far to the fielder's left.

To the left of short fine leg but not a bad ball, oh that's a good stop close to the boundary too. The fielder stops it by plonking his shoe in the way. Was a length ball around off to which Patidar went across and flicked late. From deep in the crease, off the back foot
Bad ball. Down leg with short fine leg in, the leg glance was effectively a free hit.
Launched just over cover, who leaps up and throws his left hand up but it's not in reach. Was a length ball to which Patidar made room and forced a drive
Length just outside off, cloths a heave to long-on
Length on middle and leg, worked to long-on
Waits for the slow length ball that landed on off to spin to leg, twirls quickly while pulling the ball to deep square leg
Length on off, punched to deep midwicket
Flicked off the back foot through backward square leg
That has been monstered over long-on. Patidar got leg side of the ball, lunged a bit and heaved across the line. It was an on-stumps ball that sailed 91 metres
Length around off, flicked softly to square leg.
Dances down and taps the rising length ball with an open-faced bat to point

Flayed over cover, Kohli brings up fifty. Entire dug out is up, crowd cheering on too. He raises his bat. Was a length ball with a bit of width that was flashed with a mostly horizontal bat. First four in 14 balls
Slower ball is full on fourth, flicked to long-on
Full on middle and leg, whipped to deep square leg
Test stuff. On a length, in the channel, a bit of extra bounce. Patidar tries to run it to third with a vertical bat, gets beaten
Beaten on the cut. 143ks length ball just outside off
Fullish ball on middle, flicked to deep forward square leg. 92ks
Length on middle and leg, punched with a straight bat to midwicket

Padikkal perishes trying to take Narine on, holes out to deep midwicket but Kohli gives him a fist bump on the way out. He danced down the wicket and tried to whip the length ball on the up, bat-face turned inside upon impact. Went straight to the fielder.
Sweeps the fullish ball on off to deep midwicket.
Sharp spin in after landing outside off, flicked from off stump to deep square leg. Off the back foot too
Cuts the fourth-stump length ball to deep point
Cuts the length ball from off stump to backward point for a quick single. No room on that, 99ks too
Flicked off the back foot to deep square leg
Shortish over the stumps, flicked off the back foot to long-on
Kohli slog-sweeps over long-on, raises his bat to the dugout and pumps his fists. He picked the googly, dragged it from a fullish length on fifth. Whacked off one knee.
Flicks the full ball to long-on
Cuts the fourth-stump length ball to deep point
What timing on that flick. WOW! On a length on middle and leg, he clips this with excellent timing in the gap between deep midwicket and long on

That's 1000 runs for Kohli against KKR in the IPL. Flatter on leg stump, he works this to the right of Rinku at deep midwicket. He charges in and fires a throw one-handed. Padikkal was fell down the track eyeing a second and slipped as well. But the throw was off target
Flatter on off stump, he shuffles across and ticks this to wide long-on
On a length on middle, he prods well forward and works this to deep midwicket
Flatter on leg stump at 90.6kph. Kohli looks to works this away, misses and is rapped on the pad. The ball was sliding down leg
On a length well outside off stump, Padikkal shuffles right across and whisks this  to deep midwicket
Length ball on middle and leg, he works this to deep midwicket to get off the mark
And again! Lands the leggie just outside off and turns it away at the last moment beating Padikkal's outside edge
Just what a wicket does! Drops the ball on a length just outside off and derives enough spin to beat Padikkal's outside edge

Thick outside edge and Johnson hangs on at short third. A much needed breakthrough for KKR. Legspinner well outside off. Salt throws his bat at it, gets the thick edge, and Johnson moves well to his left
Flatter and a stifle short outside off, he shapes up for the cut and misses
RCB continue on their merry ways. Legspinner but that was way too short outside off. He stays back and pulls to the left of deep backward square leg
Darts this one at 93.4kph around off stump, he stays leg side of the ball and punches to deep cover
Slows this up on a length on middle and leg, he stays back and works this to deep midwicket
Darted in at 91kph on off, he pushes to long-off for a run
Carrom ball that is stifle short outside off as Kohli hops back and pulls to deep midwicket
Quicker length ball on middle, he sweeps to short fine leg
Quicker length ball at 92kph on leg stump. He looks for a swipe across the line but misses and is rapped on the pad
Pushed quicker outside off, he checks his drive and the ball almost carries to extra cover
Fuller and flatter on off, he drives to long-off. And that is a fifty off just 25 balls for Salt. What start to his season against a team which he was an integral part of till last season
Length ball darted in at 99kph on leg stump. He wears this on the pad and there is a stifle appeal. But that was sliding down leg
Flatter on leg stump, he works this to deep backward square leg for a run
SHOT! Darted on a length on of, he gets down on one knee and slams the slog sweep to the right of deep midwicket for a four
Darted on a length outside off, he punches back to the bowler
Good length ball just outside off, he stays leg side of the ball and punches this to deep third and with an angled bat

A brilliant effort from Ramandeep, but he can't reach it.  He seems to have hurt his hand in the process as well. On a length outside off, Kohli skews this off the outside half of the blade with the ball going over point. Ramandeep sprints around from deep point, puts a solid dive forward, but can't get his hands under the ball. Jams his fingers as well in the process and is tended to by the physio
Banged in short well outside off, he shuffles well across and hacks the pull to deep backward square leg who collects this on the bounce
Juuust past leg stump. Slower offcutter on a length at 118kph. He sees Salt backing away and follows him. Salt misses, and the ball just evades leg stump
Just short of Rana. Back of a length ball outside off, he mistimes his punch back towards the bowler, who dives forward, but the ball hits him on the half-volley
Good length ball moving away from the batter after pitching as Kohli gets beaten
He has the power, he has the finesse.  Back of a length ball angling across the batter, who backs away again and pats this in the gap between point and short third
Good length ball on off stump, he backs away and pushes to point with an open face of the bat
Banged in short on off stump, pulls but straight to deep backward square leg on the bounce
Length ball outside off, he mistimes to mid-on
A repeat of the previous shot, and this he gets it 75m over the ropes. On a length angling across Kohli who shuffles across and tonks this over the bowler's head
UP AND OVER! Kohli joins in on the six-fest. Length outside off, he gets across and goes straight over the bowler's head for a 63m six. The ball hit the advertisement cushion on the full
This is batting of the highest order from Salt. Length ball darted in on leg stump. He bends down on one knee and slams the sweep to the deep square leg fence
Three in three! Length on middle and leg, he carts this over mid-on for a four more
And, again! Even better, this time around. Darted in on middle, he gives himself room and tonks this over mid-off and eventually over the ropes
SHOT! On a length on off, he clears his back leg and goes up and over mid-off easily
Misfield and they get two. Darted in at 93.3kph as Salt backs away. Varun follows him and cramps him for room as he works this past square leg
Flatter length ball just outside off, he shuffles across and works this to wide long-on
Upper cut for a one-bounce four. Banged in short outside off, he backs away and gets this over point. What a start for Salt
A gorgeous cover drive, shame it only got Kohli a single. Slot ball outside off, he creams the drive but straight to Russell at extra cover, who fumbles and allows a run
Kohli gets into the act now and the runs are flowing. On a length on off stump. He was looking to go straighter by stepping down the track, but drags this through midwicket and still gets a four.
On a length ball just outside off, he steps across and shovels this to deep backward square leg for a run
One better! The first six for RCB in IPL 2025. Right in Salt's wheelhouse on off stump as he shuffles across and tonks this for an 89m six over cow corner
In the slot and hammered! Gentle length ball just around off stump. Right in his zone and he whacks this over mid-on
Sharp short of a length ball on middle, he looks for a pull, misses and is struck in the midriff with the ball lobbing to point
Fuller well outside off, he steps across his stumps but can only dig this back to the bowler
Good length ball around off stump, he pushes this to covers
THUMPED! Length ball outside off stump, he punches this on the up and more importantly, in the gap through covers.
Length ball shaping away from Salt outside off. He pushes at it and gets beaten again
On a length angling across from Salt, who throws his bat and it but can't lay a bat on that
On a length shaping away from Kohli outside off. He opens the face of the blade and runs this past short third for a couple of runs

A four first ball for Kohli as well. Length ball shaping sharply back into Kohli on middle and leg. He flicks this through the vacant midwicket region. Harshit sprints across from deep square leg, dives but can't keep the ball inside the field of play
Runs with the shot and makes it comfortably. Length ball shaping back into Salt on middle. He pushes to mid-on and sets off. Kohli responds
On a length just around off stump with a hint of inswing. Salt pushes this towards point
Gets across his stumps to negate the inswing, but still misses the flick and is rapped on the pad. That was high though
Big booming inswinger but is starts on off and continues to go down leg. de Kock does really well to his left
CRRRRUNCHED!  Fuller length ball shaping back into Salt outside off. He takes a step down the track and absolute pummels the drive on the up through covers
